system.description: When you roll to accomplish a task involving manual dexterity or mental agility—pickpocketing, lockpicking, games involving agility, and so on—and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don’t get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. Enabler. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 12.
